initial_condition: Record the HYDRUS initial pressure head or theta field and use the equivalent MAIZSIM initial condition.
output_time: Use the same absolute or event-relative output time in both models.
boundary_conditions: Describe top, bottom, and side boundary conditions; note whether root uptake and evaporation are off or matched.
baseline_definition: Same soil, initial condition, domain, boundary conditions, and time period without drip irrigation.
